title: API Rate Limiting — Stripe Webhook Conflict
description:
The IP-based rate limiter implemented in PR #47 throttles Stripe webhook retries during high payment volume periods. Stripe uses a small range of IPs and fires 3-5 retries per failed webhook, consistently hitting the 100 req/min per-IP limit.

Approved solution (email_12): Dedicated /webhooks endpoint with HMAC signature verification, bypassing IP rate limiter. This is more secure than IP whitelisting.

Security review from Kenji (email_09) also identified additional issues with PR #47:
- X-Forwarded-For header not checked (problematic behind load balancers)
- Missing Retry-After header in 429 responses

Both issues being addressed in the updated PR #47. New PR for /webhooks endpoint to follow.

Blocker for NEX-204 Payments feature.
